name: tabular-benchmark-dataset
description: A collection of tabular datasets assembled as a benchmark suite for evaluating classical and ML models on structured data tasks. It measures model performance across diverse real-world tabular problems including classification and regression with mixed numeric and categorical features.
evaluation_method: accuracy for classification, ROC-AUC for binary classification when reported, RMSE/MSE for regression (task-dependent)
general_score_metric: task-dependent (accuracy for classification; RMSE/AUC for regression/binary tasks)
reputation: A utility dataset collection on Hugging Face for benchmarking tabular ML methods; modest adoption primarily among practitioners benchmarking classical/tabular models.
